name: MSLR-WEB10K: Microsoft Learning to Rank Benchmark Dataset
description: MSLR-WEB10K is an authoritative learning-to-rank benchmark dataset curated by Microsoft Research. Derived from search query logs of the Bing search engine, it comprises 10,000 queries and approximately 1.2 million query-document pairs. Each pair is represented by 136 numerical ranking features (e.g. BM25, PageRank, term frequencies) and annotated with human-assigned relevance labels on a 5-level grading scale (0 to 4), evaluated via 5-fold cross validation.
